name: loki_request_errors
title: Loki request errors
description: The and are experiencing a high percentage errors.

source.upstream_query: 100 * sum(rate(loki_request_duration_seconds_count{status_code=~"5.."}[1m])) by (namespace, job, route) / sum(rate(loki_request_duration_seconds_count[1m])) by (namespace, job, route) > 10 and sum(rate(loki_request_duration_seconds_count[1m])) by (namespace, job, route) > 0
source.upstream_description: The {{ $labels.job }} and {{ $labels.route }} are experiencing {{ printf "%.2f" $value }}% errors.
source.query_normalized: The upstream threshold could not be lifted out of the expression (its outermost operator is and/or/unless, or it compares against another series), so the expression is normalised to 1 per matching series and the alert fires on any match. The observed value in the notification is therefore always 1.

query_condition.promql: (100 * sum(rate(loki_request_duration_seconds_count{status_code=~"5.."}[1m])) by (namespace, job, route) / sum(rate(loki_request_duration_seconds_count[1m])) by (namespace, job, route) > 10 and sum(rate(loki_request_duration_seconds_count[1m])) by (namespace, job, route) > 0) * 0 + 1
